issue.title: Grok SASE runs load zero instruction files since ~2026-09-10 (untrusted workspaces; agents_md_files empty)

task_type_fields.impact:
## Impact

Grok is ~13% of sase-project agent runs (939 of 7,007 in the last 30 days). Behavioral signal (correlational):
among completed non-research runs with finalizers (monitor/gate turns excluded), the share that submitted a
final declaration fell from 60% (62/104) before 2026-09-11 to 26% (43/163) after, while Claude (55%->49%) and
Codex (64%->58%) moved <=6 points. `docs/agent_providers.md` "Instruction double-load" and `docs/llms.md` now
describe the wrong behavior.

## Suggested fix

Stopgap: have the Grok adapter pass the rendered instruction content explicitly via `--rules <text>` (appends
to the system prompt; independent of trust and gitignore), and set `GROK_CLAUDE_AGENTS_ENABLED=0` so a later
trust fix cannot produce a triple load. Longer term: per-invocation instruction bundles delivered by each
adapter (see the referenced research report). Add a conformance check (e.g. in `sase doctor`) that reads
Grok's `prompt_context.json` and asserts the instructions arrived exactly once.
task_type_fields.repro:
## Reproduction

1. In any SASE workspace (e.g. `~/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_<N>`), run `grok inspect`.
   It prints `Project trusted: no` and `Project Instructions (0)`, although tracked `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`
   exist at the repo root. `~/.grok/trusted_folders.toml` lists only `/home/bryan/projects/github/sase-org/sase`.
2. Tabulate `agents_md_files` from every Grok session record:
   `~/.grok/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session>/prompt_context.json`. For sessions whose `working_directory`
   is a SASE workspace: 421 of 429 sessions from 2026-08-20 to 2026-09-10 loaded 2 files (CLAUDE.md +
   AGENTS.md, the documented double load); 568 of 568 sessions from 2026-09-11 to 2026-10-05 loaded 0.
   The switch happened on 2026-09-10 (12 sessions with 0, 10 with 2 that day).
3. `src/sase/llm_provider/grok.py` passes no instruction text (no `--rules` / `--append-system-prompt`),
   so these runs receive no project or home instructions at all — no /sase_final contract, no
   /sase_repo rule, no memory routing — only skill descriptions.

Root cause is NOT confirmed: the most likely explanation is a Grok-side trust gate on project instructions
for untrusted folders shipped around 2026-09-10 (xAI's docs do not document one). Grok's docs also state
that gitignored instruction files are skipped.
